## Context

`docs/user-guide.md` is the client workflow guide established by handmade-radical-johndory. Its relation inventory omits `caused_by`. Selected sections also explain router extraction, blame-selection internals, a dated credential incident, and session pointer resolution. Those details do not help an audience that uses rebar without developing it.

## Plan

- Add `caused_by` to the client relation inventory with its supported user-facing meaning.
- Retain observable mutation output, attribution, secret screening, session-log behavior, recovery actions, supported command examples, and safety guidance.
- Replace router and blame-selection implementation detail with client behavior and links to internal documentation when developers need the mechanism.
- Replace the credential incident narrative with current recovery guidance and cite coyish-fluent-gibbon only where historical context remains useful.
- Replace session pointer implementation detail with the behavior a client can rely on.
- Run the documentation index check and focused user-guide contracts.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The user guide lists `caused_by` with its supported client meaning.
- [x] Selected workflow sections state observable client behavior without router or blame-selection implementation detail.
- [x] Credential guidance describes current recovery actions without reproducing the dated incident narrative.
- [x] Session-log guidance states discoverable behavior without pointer-resolution internals.
- [x] Existing mutation, attribution, secret-screening, command, and safety guidance remains accurate.
- [x] Documentation index and focused user-guide checks pass.
